description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a signup screen supporting OTP and password-based registration flows. It manages user input, validation, OTP requests, verification, signup processes, and navigation to the dashboard upon success.

classes.name: SignupScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the signup interface with OTP or password options.

classes.name: _SignupScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the signup form, user input, OTP flow, signup process, and navigation logic.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Sends OTP request to the backend after validating input and limits requests.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndCreate
methods.description: Verifies the entered OTP and creates the account, then navigates to the dashboard.

methods.name: _signupWithPassword
methods.description: Creates an account using email/password signup flow and navigates to the dashboard.
